title: hRediscover's grouping precondition zeroes the corroboration signal it exists to compute — found by the ED-IN-0153 run, in that run's own instrument
description: MEASURED, NOT INFERRED. The ED-IN-0153 world-schema gap audit ran 12 producer lanes across three method-disjoint passes specifically so that a gap reached by lanes from different passes would carry an independent-rediscovery signal. hRediscover returned 75 groups from 75 findings: every rediscovery value was 1. The signal was not weak, it was absent, and the synthesis stage silently reconstructed it by hand from lane labels and claim wording -- which is the worst of both outcomes, because the returned object still carries a rediscovery column that reads as measured. ROOT CAUSE: hSameFinding gates on hFirstFile(a) === hFirstFile(b) BEFORE comparing content words, and hFirstFile returns the first file-shaped token in a finding's free-text evidence string. Two lanes describing one gap from different directions rarely lead with the same citation, so the file-equality precondition zeroed the comparison before the fuzzy matcher ever ran. THE OWNER PREDICTED THIS FAILURE AND THEN INHERITED IT. tools/wf_harness.js's own comment on the exact key says: 'An exact key splits them into singletons and silently zeroes out the entire corroboration signal, which is worse than not computing it: the output still has a rediscovery column, it just always reads 1.' hSameFinding was written as the remedy for precisely that and kept the same-file precondition, so it reproduces the defect for any finding shape whose evidence is multi-citation free text. Section 0.1 point-5 signature: correct for the shape it was written against, silently wrong for the shape that arrived later. SCOPE: NOT FIXED HERE. The owner is copied verbatim into every .claude/wf_*.js, its behaviour is pinned by tests/valoria/test_wf_harness.py (mutation-verified 13/13), and the grouping rule needs its own expected-delta test rather than a drop-in edit -- widening an audit PR into a harness change is the scope creep section 0.1 point 5 warns about. Filed for its own pass. ED-IN-0153's orchestration plan section 6 predicted this limit as 'a floor, never a ceiling -- it under-reports corroboration and cannot over-report it'. That prediction is FALSIFIED in the direction that matters: it did not under-report, it reported nothing. The correction is recorded in audit/2026-08-11-world-schema-gap-audit/02_verdict_and_residuals.md section 2.
falsifier: THE GUARD IS THE DELIVERABLE, NOT THE PATCH. Any fix must ship with a test that fails when two findings describing one defect through DIFFERENT first-cited files collapse to two singletons -- i.e. a fixture of two paraphrases citing different files must group to rediscovery 2. Without that test the pattern recurs invisibly, which is exactly what happened here: the existing suite is green and mutation-verified, and did not catch it, because it pins that signal() never throws and that a tripped run still returns a summary -- not that grouping groups. Reproduce the defect now: the ED-IN-0153 run returned raw_findings 75 / distinct_gaps 75 with rediscovery_top all 1s.
